text: He is Allah, the One worshipped with truth, who has no deity other than Him, the Sovereign over all things, the Disposer of them without opposition or resistance, the One exalted above every deficiency, the One free from every flaw, the One who confirms His messengers and prophets with the clear signs He sent them with, the Watcher over all His creation in their deeds, the Almighty who cannot be overcome, the Compeller who has subdued all servants, and all creation has submitted to Him, the Proud who possesses pride and majesty. Allah, the Exalted, is exalted above everything they associate with Him in His worship.
